requestBody.query: How to program my Bell Satellite TV remote control

200.answer: To program your Bell Satellite TV remote, make sure the batteries are charged and remove obstructions. If it's not controlling the receiver, program it. For a UHF remote, install the UHF antenna. You can also get a replacement remote online.

snippets.text: Should you need to replace your remote, you can get one online. View our Satellite TV remote controls Satellite TV remote (6500 and all other receivers) Before you begin, make sure the batteries are charged and remove obstructions between your remote and the receiver. Learn more Learn how to program your Bell Satellite TV remote How to program your bell satellite tv remote - opens a video modal dialog To operate your receiver If you find that your Bell Satellite TV remote is not controlling your receiver properly, or if you recently purchased a replacement remote, follow these steps to program it. Important: If you have a UHF remote (check the bottom of your remote), you first need to install the UHF antenna provided by Bell into its port on the back of your receiver. Press SYS INFO on the front of the receiver. Press and hold SAT until SAT, TV, AUX and VCR light up. Release SAT. It will start to flash. Choose a random number between 0 and 16 and enter it.

snippets.text: Call us at 1 866 797-8686 Other ways to contact us How to program my Bell Satellite TV remote control Select your remote: Slim remote (9500, 7500, 6500 only) Slim remote Satellite TV remote (6500 and all other receivers) Satellite TV remote Slim remote (9500, 7500, and 6500 only) Before you begin, make sure the batteries are charged and remove obstructions between your remote and the receiver. Learn more To operate your Whole Home PVR or receiver If you find that your Bell Satellite TV remote is not controlling your receiver properly, or if you recently purchased a replacement remote, follow these steps to program it. Press and hold the options button for three seconds until the green light blinks twice. Enter 0006 on your remote keypad (for satellite receivers). The green tv light will flash twice again and your remote will now operate your satellite receiver. Note: If that does not solve the issue, you may need to reset the frequency by following the next few steps.
